text:
elaine: Pushed a quick blendbench run for zebra-13b quant + speculative path. TL;DR: 1.7x median token throughput with prefetch=on, small drop on long-form QA. link: https://internal.blend/artefacts/1753210000

joel: nice, can you paste the exact cmd/config used?

elaine: sure — main flags: prefetch=on, speculative=soft, beam=1, kv-warmup=100. repro:
```
python -m bench.spec_decode --model zebra-13b-q --sequences 200 --prefetch on --speculative soft --kv_warmup 100 --batch 16
```

sam: quick q — is this using the new quant LUT pass? that was supposed to change logit scaling slightly.

elaine: yes — lut-pass=v2 was enabled. I ran a control without it (same runset) and perf was identical but QA exact-match dropped ~1.8% on NaturalQuestions subset.

maria: hmm 1.8% EM is non-trivial. do you have per-question examples? could be length bias from early speculative exit.

elaine: grabbed few failure diffs, looks like longer context answers get truncated when speculative decides early token is high prob. example in artefact. suspect earlystop threshold too aggressive for QA.

joel: maybe increase speculative confidence floor or add a min-steps for open-domain QA. also want to compare nll trajectories between lut v1/v2.

sam: +1 on nll check. also add eval of canonical prompts with long tails (>=1200 tokens) to see rate of truncation.

elaine: plan: 1) run nll comparison v1/v2 (2000 samples), 2) sweep speculative threshold [0.6,0.75,0.9], 3) rerun QA EM check with min-steps=4. will post results ~in 1.5h.

infra-bot: artifact created: gs://redwood-artifacts/eng-ml/1753210000/blendbench.tar.gz (md5: a1b2c3d4)

joel: cool — if you want I can spin up a dedicated 4xA10 job to run the sweep faster.

elaine: that would help, thanks. tagging @maria for QA evaluation prefs. :thumbsup:
